home.productsSub: Four cutting methods. One precision standard.

cuttingMethodCards.name: Score Cut
cuttingMethodCards.description: Circular blade against a hardened anvil roller — clean edges on films, paper, and nonwovens.

cuttingMethodCards.name: Shear Cut
cuttingMethodCards.description: Scissor-action precision for metallic foils, heavy board, and thick films.

cuttingMethodCards.name: Half Cut
cuttingMethodCards.description: Cuts the top layer, keeps the liner intact — built for medical laminates and labels.

cuttingMethodCards.name: Hot Cut
cuttingMethodCards.description: Heated blade fuses synthetic edges while cutting — no fraying, no loose fibers.
